title: VexaScript project configuration
description: Configures VexaScript project discovery, compilation, module resolution, global declarations, and build or serve output.

entrypoint.description: The .vx or .ts entry file used when a CLI command receives a project directory.

outDir.description: Output directory for project builds. A command-line --out value takes precedence.

outputDir.description: Legacy alias for outDir. Prefer outDir in new projects.

compilerOptions.description: TypeScript-compatible compiler options currently consumed by VexaScript.

lib.description: Built-in declaration libraries made available to the project.

types.description: Ambient declaration packages to load. An empty array disables values inherited from tsconfig.json.

baseUrl.description: Base directory for non-relative source imports, resolved from this configuration file.

jsxFactory.description: Function used to emit JSX elements.

jsxFragmentFactory.description: Value used to emit JSX fragments.

jsxImportSource.description: Maps JSX emission to Preact's classic h and Fragment factories. Automatic JSX runtime emission is not yet supported.

canonicalSyntax.description: Selects the declaration spellings used by editor normalization and generated quick fixes.

importMappings.description: Maps exact module specifiers to local source files for JavaScript compilation, module resolution, and editor navigation.

imports.description: Legacy alias for importMappings. Prefer importMappings in new projects.

globalSymbols.description: Loads source files whose declarations should be available globally without imports.

paths.description: Source files or directories containing global declarations.

emit.description: Whether declarations are emitted onto globalThis or assumed to be provided by the runtime host.

serveMappings.description: Publishes files or directories at public paths during serve and copies them into project build output.

oneOf.description: Maps source paths to public destination paths.
Legacy array form of source-to-destination mappings.

from.description: Source file or directory relative to vexascript.json.

to.description: Destination path relative to the served or built site root.
